comment: FICTIONAL example governor for contrib/. Three machines: web1 serves the shop and has no failover (frozen), db1 holds the database (lockdown), edge1 is the reverse proxy and the designated test host. Copy over the repo's vpscfg-control.json, then replace the hosts with your own. deny_always must contain at least the compiled-in floor; removing an entry refuses everything.

scopes.graduation_rule: A scope enters 'unlocked' only after it appears in 'tested' with result=pass. Progression is container -> pod -> service -> host, one scope at a time. Each unlock is one edit, one commit, one scope.

web1.reason: serves www.example.com; the only web host, no failover. Mutations only through a committed break_glass runbook

web1.example.internal.reason: internal FQDN of web1, the same machine. Postures must match the canonical host

db1.reason: primary database; reads only unless a committed break_glass runbook names the command

edge1.reason: reverse proxy in front of web1; designated test host, where it is safe to be wrong first
